description: This file implements the MiracastCommon and MiracastThread classes, providing functionalities such as thread management, message queue handling, system command execution, and option file parsing within the Miracast project.

classes.name: MiracastThread
classes.description: A class that manages thread creation, message queuing, and synchronization for Miracast operations.

classes.name: MiracastCommon
classes.description: A utility class providing system-related functions such as executing commands and parsing options.

methods.name: parse_opt_flag
methods.description: Reads a file to parse options or flags, with optional validation as integer.

methods.name: execute_SystemCommand
methods.description: Executes a system command using system() and returns its result.

methods.name: execute_PopenCommand
methods.description: Executes a command using popen(), waits for specific output if needed, with retries and interval.
